### Issue URL (Incorrect Blocking) [https://www.hulu.com/watch/a7976d43-3985-4dc2-9099-ec1767d6a031](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.hulu.com%2Fwatch%2Fa7976d43-3985-4dc2-9099-ec1767d6a031) ### Comment > It used to be that using Adguard on Hulu let you fast forward through commercials and the captions and pic would get out of sync, and you'd have to click "watch credits" in order to see the end of the episode because things would be, by the end of a show, 4-5 minutes out of sync. Now with Adguard running you can still ffwd through commercials, but the "out of sync" problem makes it so the episode will end early, sometimes just cutting off a few minutes sometimes cutting off over 5 minutes (whatever is after the last commercial). It's inconsistent how much time is lost but with AdGuard running there's no way to see the last few minutes of the episode, you have to turn it off, let it reload, watch a few commercials, in order to see the last few minutes of each episode. issue.body:
# Sorry. The website is infected by AdShield, Inc.

Unfortunately, It is complicated to resolve with a regular adblock rule because the website is being protected by service of Ad-Shield that is an anti-adblock company.

## Userscript Installation
Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).
Please check its installation guideline written in English by visiting [this URL](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.md).

If you can understand Korean language, please refer https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.ko.md.

New change of tinyShield's build script for Apple Safari Extension user (made at 2026 Apr 21) is available.

## Still Have a Problem?
An issue is occurred when the userscript is applied, please report to [this issue tracker](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues).

>Google Social Ad Banner

Fixed.

>I am not able to create a winfuture report issue, when I click continue with report. It's always stuck in a loading circle:

Looks like related to https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/229279#issuecomment-5129435903, and probably possible temporary workaround - https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/229279#issuecomment-5176157181

Also should fix it:
```adblock
reports.adguard.com#$##report_app div[class]:has(> div:not([class]) > iframe[src^="https://newassets.hcaptcha.com/captcha/"]) { visibility: visible !important; }
```

I will ask about that.

comment.body:
Please Close This Issue, because I Fix This Right Away! Haha :D
Now , just wanted to share a fix for the web NCM(Netease Cloud Music) (music.163.com) banner ads:
    Main:NetEase uses CSS modules with randomized dynamic hashes (like _g90gl5l), so fixed element selectors keep breaking after a refresh. Using class wildcard rules solves it without messing up personalized song recommendations below.

Adding these wildcard rules works like a charm:
• music.163.com##[class*="BannerWrapper"]
• music.163.com##[class*="BannerView"]
• music.163.com###page_pc_home > div.recent-listen-context.gridWrapperCls_g90gl5l > div:first-child > div.shorten.GridCarouselWrapper_gcvcmmp > div.content > div.rail-wrapper > div.item-main > div.bannerWrapperCls_b10ae4x0:first-child

Hope this helps anyone facing the same issue! 🚀

issue.body:
### Issue URL (Incorrect Blocking)
[https://apps.apple.com/it/app/buddy-unicredit/id1485778858](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fapps.apple.com%2Fit%2Fapp%2Fbuddy-unicredit%2Fid1485778858)

### Comment
> When AdGuard DNS is enabled on my iPhone, the official buddy UniCredit (Genius buddy) app cannot open the in-app support chat ("Chatta con noi").
> 
> Steps to reproduce:
> 
> Enable AdGuard DNS.
> Open the buddy UniCredit app.
> Tap "Chatta con noi".
> A loading spinner appears briefly.
> The app immediately returns to the Home screen without displaying any error.
> 
> Expected behavior:
> The support chat should open.
> 
> Actual behavior:
> The app returns to the Home screen.
> 
> Disabling AdGuard DNS (same iPhone, same Wi-Fi network, same app version) immediately fixes the issue and the support chat opens correctly.
> 
> Device:
> 
> iPhone 17 Pro Max
> iOS 26.5.2
> buddy UniCredit app 3.75.0
> 
> Two screenshots are attached:
> 
> AdGuard DNS enabled: loading spinner, then back to the Home screen.
> AdGuard DNS disabled: the support chat opens normally.



### Screenshots
<details>
  <summary>Screenshot 1</summary>

  ![Screenshot 1](https://cdn.adguardcdn.com/sitereports/k1ovqm8ns34sc408g4cosckk0008k404flv654c598.jpg?nc=1)

issue.body:
### Issue URL (Incorrect Blocking)
[https://apps.apple.com/it/app/buddy-unicredit/id1485778858](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fapps.apple.com%2Fit%2Fapp%2Fbuddy-unicredit%2Fid1485778858)

### Comment
> When AdGuard DNS is enabled on my iPhone, the official buddy UniCredit (Genius buddy) app cannot open the in-app support chat ("Chatta con noi").
> 
> Steps to reproduce:
> 
> Enable AdGuard DNS.
> Open the buddy UniCredit app.
> Tap "Chatta con noi".
> A loading spinner appears briefly.
> The app immediately returns to the Home screen without displaying any error.
> 
> Expected behavior:
> The support chat should open.
> 
> Actual behavior:
> The app returns to the Home screen.
> 
> Disabling AdGuard DNS (same iPhone, same Wi-Fi network, same app version) immediately fixes the issue and the support chat opens correctly.
> 
> Device:
> 
> iPhone 17 Pro Max
> iOS 26.5.2
> buddy UniCredit app 3.75.0
> 
> Two screenshots are attached:
> 
> AdGuard DNS enabled: loading spinner, then back to the Home screen.
> AdGuard DNS disabled: the support chat opens normally.



### Screenshots
<details>
  <summary>Screenshot 1</summary>

  ![Screenshot 1](https://cdn.adguardcdn.com/sitereports/k1ovqm8ns34sc408g4cosckk0008k404flv654c598.jpg?nc=1)
</details>

<details>
  <summary>Screenshot 1 with AdGuard disabled</summary>

  ![Screenshot 1](https://cdn.adguardcdn.com/sitereports/j1aaxektm7cosw4wk0c00k4c88ggog0okuefhm7rc0.png?nc=1)
</details>

Browser: | Official buddy UniCredit iOS app

### Issue URL (Incorrect Blocking) [http://mail.unicst.com/alimail/entries/v5.1/mail/inbox/all](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=http%3A%2F%2Fmail.unicst.com%2Falimail%2Fentries%2Fv5.1%2Fmail%2Finbox%2Fall) ### Comment > 我在网页上使用邮箱，这个邮箱，在刚登录时经常弹出一个广告，默认没有拦截，我手动拦截，识别添加的过滤器是： > mail.unicst.com##div:nth-child(6) > mail.unicst.com##div:nth-child(7) > 增加了这2条用户过滤器后，登录时确实不再弹出广告了。 > 但是增加用户过滤器后，就会在我向浏览器的邮件正文处粘贴复制的文字时拦截一部分复制过去的邮件正文的内容，让这些内容无法显示出来。具体操作是先在Windows记事本程序中写好正文内容，复制，粘贴到网页的邮件正文处。 > 在前面的屏幕截图中，我只保留了 > mail.unicst.com##div:nth-child(6) > 这个过滤器，结果就是把我粘贴到正文的连续7行内容的第6行拦截隐藏了。如果我把 > mail.unicst.com##div:nth-child(7) > 也加进去，第7行也会被拦截隐藏。 > 删掉自定义规则，或者禁用，就没有正文被隐藏的问题。 ### Screenshots
Screenshot 1 ![Screenshot 1](https://reports.adguard.info/stcdn/sitereports/2schblsumkowwg000048wckcskw48gw1npt2k1sg5f.png?nc=1)
Screenshot 1 with AdGuard disabled ![Screenshot 1](https://reports.adguard.info/stcdn/sitereports/1b3jw0x13qm88owos888wk8wcs0oks8pmwnt30c1dw.png?nc=1)

建议您下次直接报告广告，并提供有效用户规则以及启用它所造成的问题。

issue.body:
# Sorry. The website is infected by AdShield, Inc.

Unfortunately, It is complicated to resolve with a regular adblock rule because the website is being protected by service of Ad-Shield that is an anti-adblock company.

## Userscript Installation
Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).
Please check its installation guideline written in English by visiting [this URL](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.md).

If you can understand Korean language, please refer https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.ko.md.

New change of tinyShield's build script for Apple Safari Extension user (made at 2026 Apr 21) is available.

## Still Have a Problem?
An issue is occurred when the userscript is applied, please report to [this issue tracker](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues).

issue.body:
### Issue URL (Incorrect Blocking) [https://meksikatur.ru/oteli-v-kankune](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fmeksikatur.ru%2Foteli-v-kankune) ### Comment > Здравствуйте! > Проблема отображения партнёрских виджетов от Travelpayouts. > > При установке подключения роутера к личному Adguard DNS виджеты перестают отображаться. > > При любых настройках виджеты не отображаются. Даже при выключенном DNS в настройках панели управления. Убраны все фильтры и блокировки. В белый список добавлен сам сайт, где должны отображаться виджеты, так и домены виджетов: tpemd.com, emrldtp.com. > При удалении на роутере подключения к Adguard DNS все виджеты отображаются корректно. > > Странный момент! > При включенной фильтрации DNS сервера, к которому подключен и Adguard VPN, включить VPN, то виджеты открываются. > > Я не стал подключать GPT, чтоб он Вам всё разжевал, думаю, тут и так всё понятно. Виджеты emrldtp.com, tpemd.com от партнёрки Travelpayouts блокируются при подключении DNS роутера Кинетик Рейсер. > > Очень нравится пользоваться вашими продуктами. Жду решения проблемы. Спасибо! ### Screenshots
Screenshot 1 ![Screenshot 1](https://reports.adguard.info/stcdn/sitereports/1fy6n3ysbecgc4k8o04k4ockgcwgw8w5il9sa1uqz0.png?nc=1)

Dandelion Sprout's Game Console Adblock List,
Perflyst and Dandelion Sprout's Smart-TV Blocklist

issue.title: www.yorkshireeveningpost.co.uk

labels.name: A: Problematic
labels.description: Issues, which cannot be resolved easily

issue.body:
# Sorry. The website is infected by AdShield, Inc.

Unfortunately, It is complicated to resolve with a regular adblock rule because the website is being protected by service of Ad-Shield that is an anti-adblock company.

## Userscript Installation
Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).
Please check its installation guideline written in English by visiting [this URL](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.md).

If you can understand Korean language, please refer https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.ko.md.

New change of tinyShield's build script for Apple Safari Extension user (made at 2026 Apr 21) is available.

## Still Have a Problem?
An issue is occurred when the userscript is applied, please report to [this issue tracker](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues).

# Sorry. The website is infected by AdShield, Inc.

Unfortunately, It is complicated to resolve with a regular adblock rule because the website is being protected by service of Ad-Shield that is an anti-adblock company.

## Userscript Installation
Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).
Please check its installation guideline written in English by visiting [this URL](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.md).

If you can understand Korean language, please refer https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.ko.md.

New change of tinyShield's build script for Apple Safari Extension user (made at 2026 Apr 21) is available.

## Still Have a Problem?
An issue is occurred when the userscript is applied, please report to [this issue tracker](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues).
